question.text: Which of the following statements/relationships is not correct in thermodynamic changes ?

options.text: $\mathrm{w}=-\mathrm{nRT} \ln \frac{\mathrm{V}_2}{\mathrm{~V}_1}$ (isothermal reversible expansion of an ideal gas)
$\mathrm{w}=\mathrm{nRT} \ln \frac{\mathrm{V}_2}{\mathrm{~V}_1}$ (isothermal reversible expansion of an ideal gas)
For a system of constant volume heat involved directly changes to internal energy.

solution.text:
For isothermal reversible expansion.
$$
w=-n R T \ln \frac{V_2}{V_1}
$$
